list: The full official trophy list for PlayStation 5 as published — 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions, grades and counts are the official list (checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18).
missableRule: A trophy counts as MISSABLE when its official description pins it to one named story mission, to the last mission of one character's strand, to a moment when your partner has to be with you, or to a single story beat that happens once. Chapter trophies and the finale are not flagged — finishing the story earns them. Counted sets and collectibles are not flagged either — their descriptions leave them open in free roam after the story.
sourcing: Only names, descriptions, grades and counts come from the official list. Each guide below was written for this entry from that description alone. GTA VI released on 19 November 2026, so no finished playthrough exists yet to copy steps from — and none is copied here. Where a description gives no place or step, the guide says so instead of guessing one.

trophies.guide: There is nothing to do for this one directly: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Treat the 100% completion gold as the real finish line; once that lands, the platinum follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing, the game's opening mission, and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is flagged only because the description ties it to that one mission — finish the mission and it is yours.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy arrives with the chapter's end. Nothing extra is asked, so it cannot be missed by any playthrough that keeps following the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 2 to the end. Like the other chapter trophies it asks only for the chapter itself, so it lands automatically as the story moves on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and this unlocks when the chapter closes. No side objective is named; just play the missions in order.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale, and the trophy pops as it ends. A completion trophy only — no optional task is attached.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Beat the final mission and this gold is yours. It is the story's endpoint, so anyone who finishes the campaign earns it; the description names no choice inside the mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Flagged because it belongs to that one mission alone: play it through to the end. The description names no extra objective inside it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is tied to that single mission, so finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Flagged for the same reason: one mission, one trophy. See it through and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. One mission, one trophy — finish it and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Flagged because the description attaches it to that one mission; finish it and it is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Tied to that single mission, so playing it to the end is all it takes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: the game's own tally across story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles. It is the long one, not a hard one — the in-game stats show what is still missing. Clear the flagged story trophies first, then work the counted sets in this guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in total — jumps, airtime, near misses and the rest — anywhere in Leonida. The count is cumulative and no place or vehicle is set, so it builds up while you travel; mop up the remainder with repeated jumps in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the set. One attempt at each is enough — the description asks for a try, not a win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold in every one — a pass is not enough — which makes this the hardest skill trophy on the list. Save it until your weapons are upgraded, then work the challenges one by one. It stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location, so visit every race spot and win there. The description lists no locations, so follow the race markers in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so spread your wins across the race list. Races stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head, so fishing on your own does not count. The description names no spot, so take the challenge wherever Cal offers it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at any arcade machine. Any game qualifies and no high score is asked — pick the shortest one you find and see it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. Flagged because it is that one last mission for this character: once his strand closes, there is no later mission of his to fall back on.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Flagged for the same reason — one final mission, and the strand ends with it. Play his missions in order and finish the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. One last mission for Billy; finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish the character finals in stage 2 and this silver follows.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Flagged because it belongs to that one last mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. One final mission for Tyrone — complete his strand in order and finish it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Find each spot and meditate there; the description gives no list, so use the in-game markers and sweep the regions in order.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Flagged because it is tied to Bret's hunt and a unique animal is a one-off quarry — take the hunt when Bret offers it. The description names no species or place, so follow Bret's directions inside the mission.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. A set only counts when every card in it is found; the description gives no locations, so sweep the map and use the collection screen to see which sets are close.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Repeats do not count — only different locations. Work through the map region by region; the locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total across every challenge type the game tracks. Many will finish themselves while you chase other trophies; check the challenges screen for what is close and clear the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops and escape. Flagged because it needs your partner with you — a story window. Do it while the story still puts you together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Flagged because it needs your partner. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Variety is what counts, not repeats — get in or register a vehicle type you have not found before. Drive everything you see and use the collection screen to spot gaps.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger the slow-time aiming mode when five enemies are grouped in front of you and drop all five before it ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout gives you the numbers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight. Take any plane you can reach on the airfield and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction — it just says it is kind of hot in these Rhinos. The honest read: Rhino tanks show up at high wanted levels, so push the heat to the top and deal with the tanks that roll in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: get in, take the goods and get out before anyone spots you or the alarm trips. Move slowly, watch sightlines and leave before the store can react.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies, so each one needs a plan and a getaway. The count is cumulative across the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — find one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the cops close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The counter climbs as you set foot in each named area, so the work is a full map sweep: drive, fly and walk into every corner. Use the map to find the grey patches.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One hit per gang, not nine hits on the same gang. The description names no gang list or operation spots, so use the in-game markers for gang activity.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail. The description names the beach, not a specific bar, so any beachside spot that serves cocktails should count.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick any vehicle showroom and make your exit through the window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through: finish a game there. The description names that alley, so go to that one. No score is named, so a completed game is what counts.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: a partnership with mass appeal. Flagged because it reads as a single story beat about the partnership, not a repeatable free-roam task. Play the story naturally and watch for a partnership moment that draws a crowd; no place or step is named, so none is invented here.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices until the counter the game tracks reaches 500. Choices are the small decisions the game keeps count of, so this completes itself across a long playthrough if you keep engaging with choice moments instead of skipping them. Flagged because choices belong to story beats.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail something once, then succeed on the second try. The honest read is that it pops when you retry a failed attempt and land it. If a mission or activity fails, run it again straight away.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: something strange happens, once. Flagged because it reads as a single scripted weird moment in the story, not a repeatable task. Play the story with your eyes open; no place or trigger is named, so none is invented.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock them down like pins. One good pass through a group does it; the description asks for the drive-by itself, not a count.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and contacts clean them for a cut, so the work is: rob, launder, repeat until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Any shop counts and the total is cumulative, so buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play. Save this for late, when money is plentiful, and it will nearly complete itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property market, so save up and buy each one as it becomes available. The description names no locations, so use the in-game property listings.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one in the app until the count hits 10. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the common ones you pass every day.
trophies.name: On the Spot
